items.title: 68514_Horace Henderson oral history interview
items.q: I used to notice Stuff when he was performing.

ctx.x: But those things happen. But getting back to Stuff, Stuff could walk through the audience and holler over to a guy, want to know what time the restaurants close and all this thing, and at the same time, man, he's playing some classics, so they're just moving. I can't -- I don't know how the guy could do it. I know a lot of guys can do this. But do you know the answer to that?
I sure don't. I really don't. I can say that I know many pianists that can do it. Could Fletcher? Do you recall?
